values.note: Every site has water and 30/50 A; sites 20-25 add sewer.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/camping ('Each site consists of packed sand and has individual water and 30 & 50 amp electrical hookups. Campsites #20-25 also include sewer hookup'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 19 water/electric sites and 6 full-hookup sites (#20-25) on packed sand; some take RVs up to 35 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 19 sites'; 'Full Hookup Sites ... 6 sites, #20-25'; 'Some sites accommodate RVs up to 35 feet') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/campsites ('the 25 campsites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; Dump Station: Yes; 'No Wifi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/aiken/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

note: Pine/hardwood forest near the South Fork Edisto River and small park lakes. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 25 sites (19 W/E + 6 full hookup, #20-25), 30/50 A, RVs to 35 ft, showers, dump; added no Wi-Fi; booking confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window, 2-night minimum (AWH phone waiver) and 14-night max, now on the entry. Flush toilets left as derived (page says only restrooms). Fees left as read 2026-10-11. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: season, pull-throughs.
